dedupe_keys.name: digital appendix of surrogate modeling of structural seismic response using probabilistic learning on manifolds

description: Digital Appendix of "Surrogate Modeling of Structural Seismic Response Using Probabilistic Learning on Manifolds" is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sanjay Govindjee, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This is the digital appendix of "Surrogate Modeling of Structural Seismic Response Using Probabilistic Learning on Manifolds". Probabilistic Learning on Manifolds (PLoM) is used as an alternative method of predicting seismic response of building structures. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-rybt-pr11. Keywords: Probabilistic Learning on Manifolds, machine learning, seismic response prediction, site specific, multiple stripe analysis, incremental dynamic analysis. Published 2022-10-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
